answer: Identity bonds decay like karst. Each agent posts a 50 POA bond to join, tagged with a pigment marker so one owner cannot hide many identities. The bond's kernel shrinks 5% every epoch, so an identity survives only if its owner tops it up with work. Forging 100 fakes costs 5,000 POA plus 250 POA per epoch in decay, while each fake earns at most 8 POA. Honest agents pay once and keep the full reward instead of splitting it across dying copies.
